model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the "effect" of various models across different language categories. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "family," ordered from left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical value axis, labeled "effect," employs a linear scale with numerical tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at 0, 10, 20, and 30; the vertical axis range extends visually from slightly below 0 to approximately 35 to accommodate the markings. Within each language family category on the horizontal axis, data is presented as a clustered group of six side-by-side bars. A legend located in the upper right defines these bars by color: a light blue bar represents "mBERT-L₂," a dark blue bar represents "XLM-L₂," a light green bar represents "mBERT-R₂," a dark green bar represents "XLM-R₂," a light pink bar represents "mBERT-B₂," and a red bar represents "XLM-B₂." Each bar features a black outline and a vertical black error bar indicating data variance. Bar heights fluctuate significantly; the shortest bars, representing values near zero or negative numbers, are predominantly located in the Isolate and Uralic families across all categories, as well as the light green mBERT-R₂ bar in the Semitic group which dips to approximately -2. Conversely, the tallest individual bar is the light pink mBERT-B₂ in the IE-Indic family group, indicating a value of approximately 24. Other pronounced measurements include the red XLM-B₂ bar in the Semitic family at near 20, which also possesses an error bar extending to the highest overall point on the chart at roughy 34. The horizontal axis categories appear grouped sequentially by the "IE-" prefix followed by the remaining families, and no individual bars are visually emphasized beyond the uniform color scheme and outlining applied throughout.
